final_verification.certification: 63 scoped library-delegation dispositions verified or rejected. Inherited auth/history defects remain open application issues, not introduced regressions.

inherited_findings.observed: Baseline and current accept foreign, userinfo and malformed-port :authority with valid bearer. Baseline rejects each without bearer and rejects an explicit foreign Host.
inherited_findings.root_cause: host_allowed validates only HeaderMap Host. Its HTTP/2 absent-Host branch returns true without inspecting request.uri().authority(), where :authority is carried. The typed-authority replacement did not change that branch.
inherited_findings.contract: The strict trusted Host/authority contract is incomplete for HTTP/2. This is a bearer-gated authority-policy gap, not demonstrated unauthenticated access. HTTP/3 was not executed.
inherited_findings.minimum_future_fix_not_applied: At the authenticated request boundary, explicitly validate the protocol authority and define disagreement handling if a Host header is also supplied. Keep bearer mandatory and preserve lexical port and configured-host policy.
inherited_findings.regression_recipe: Use the recorded H2 client over a fresh real host. Send absent Host with :authority evil.example, u@localhost and localhost:bad. Keep valid bearer and then omit it. Also send a foreign explicit Host and local controls. Assert agreed policy without changing unrelated auth semantics.

inherited_findings.observed: Baseline and current accept local-first foreign-second Origin over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2. Baseline rejects reversed order and rejects either duplicate case without bearer.
inherited_findings.root_cause: authenticate uses headers().get(ORIGIN), selecting the first value. It never validates multiplicity or examines later Origin values. This selection was unchanged by the audit.
inherited_findings.contract: The intended strict Origin guard does not cover repeated fields. A valid owner bearer remains necessary. This experiment does not demonstrate a browser sending duplicate Origin or an unauthenticated exploit.
inherited_findings.minimum_future_fix_not_applied: Choose an explicit duplicate-Origin contract before implementation. If strict single-origin semantics are intended, reject repeated values at the boundary and retain the current one-value URL policy. No automatic policy change was made.
inherited_findings.regression_recipe: Replay the raw H1 wires and H2 array headers for local-first foreign-second, reversed order, foreign-only, local-only and no-bearer cases.

inherited_findings.observed: The clean baseline retained eight visible history rows before restart, then returned empty history. The same key returned a different requestId and caused two completion requests plus one recall embedding. The no-restart control preserved history, acceptance and provider count. The SQL mind operation and memory ID survived independently.
inherited_findings.root_cause: Rig SessionLogPlugin restores Agent, AgentId, Conversation and registered saved components in PreStartup. CompanionAgent and WorkAgent are plain non-saved components. Host Startup reconcile cannot identify restored agents by those roles, creates a new role-bearing agent with the same stable AgentId, then retires the roleless restored agent. Rig appends retired. Saving the unrelated empty conversation under that same log ID appends reset. History and ene.accepted receipts are read from the replacement empty Conversation, so retry creates another acceptance and model turn.
inherited_findings.contract: Completed conversation history and chat request-key acceptance are not restart-durable, even though bytes remain in the append-only log and SQL mind_operations is durable. This is not an all-green persistence result. Work-agent restart effects are source-inferred and not separately exercised here.
inherited_findings.first_fault_boundary: Host reconciliation of already-restored Rig agents by unsaved role components, before history projection, cached SQL or Serde parsing. This boundary is present in the executed d26a49b baseline.
inherited_findings.minimum_future_fix_not_applied: Rebind persisted stable AgentId values to domain roles before spawn/stray retirement. Preserve the restored Conversation and do not Retire a valid restored domain agent. Alternatively persist and register the role components with a migration plan. The identity-rebind option is the smaller candidate, not an implemented fix.
inherited_findings.regression_recipe: Run this baseline runner against a future exact-artifact launcher. Seed completed plain and tool turns, archive JSONL and SQL, duplicate the key without restart, then SIGTERM and relaunch the exact binary on the same state. Verify identical history, identical acceptance, zero replay provider calls, no retired/reset for the valid companion, and one SQL operation/memory after identical tool replay. Add an open-work-agent case before broadening the claim.

final_verification.historical_native_exit_gap: The original combined child native job exit status is unavailable after resume. Pointer evidence was independently read. A fresh parent-owned short-runtime motion job exited0 and its7 probe checks and process/socket cleanup passed. No claim that the original combined job passed.

limits: Linux Wayland/RADV and live loopback Connect tested. Windows target/native and multiseat were not executed.
Rapid pointer removal and restoration within one buffered batch produces a phantom click in both baseline and fixed avatar. The fixed A01 regression is separate pointer-capability loss.
Missing bwrap still falls back unisolated with Isolation::Missing and notice. The pre-existing README describes refusal. No sandbox policy change was silently made.
Plugin grants capture credential snapshots. Broker handles can survive calls/cancellation. Revocation does not retract events already queued. No invocation-isolation claim.

Device approve-then-move-before-dispatch could not be forced through the public API. Its orderings have only bounded-model coverage. A reissued current-generation consent card after move is outside that single-approval model.

Controlled local provider, MCP and device fixtures prove selected protocols and bindings. No real cloud-provider, real external ACP agent, physical device action, long-run load/leak or performance-speedup claim.

summary.basis: Safe equivalent replacements and scoped partial delegations, not unconditional adoption of every proposal. Tests-only retention is not implementation; T06 expressly requests test infrastructure.
